race.title: All-Weather Championship Is Back EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
race.verdict: This looks a good opportunity for BIBURY STAR , who caught the eye finishing well on his recent debut at Wolverhampton. I Know You By Now should improve on his opening effort at Newmarket, while expensive yearling Vallejo shouldn't be totally discounted given he hails from a stable whose runners can improve markedly on their second starts. BIBURY STAR (IRE) I KNOW YOU BY NOW (IRE) VALLEJO (IRE)
